errorSummary: Verified and fixed the KAG pipeline and trace MCP startup on Windows. Serialized the Gemma4 MCP smoke, narrowed heavy KAG probes, fixed ensure-mcp-server spawning, removed duplicate mcp:trace script warning, and confirmed kag:error dry-run, kag:error real run, and kag:ingest all succeed.
researchNotes: kag:error now writes artifact runs and pending ingest JSONL; kag:ingest flushes pending queue once trace-mcp-server is restarted with the current source. Live tool registry now includes kag.record_agent_run and kag.ingest_memory_directory.
